0022600201.text: The Clippers host the New Orleans Pelicans with the Clippers at 1-7, including a 1-3 mark at home and a seven-game losing streak, placing them 4th in the Pacific and 13th in the West. The Pelicans are 4-4 on a four-game winning streak and 10th in the West, and they still have one more game to play before this one. Ingram, Beal, Miller and Niederhauser are out for the Clippers, while Missi is out for New Orleans. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, were split 2-2 in 2025-26, and the Clippers' last meeting was a 105-99 loss in New Orleans on March 19, 2026.
